newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Flextech, DBS says.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Flextech, DBS says.

text.p: DBS investment research repeated on Wednesday a buy recommendation on electronics and industrial distributor Flextech Holdings.

DBS said in a note to clients the firm would gain from a licencing agreement signed by its unit, Flexera, and U.S.-based Tessera Corp. Under the deal, Flexera will be given the right to make a new type of packaging for microchips.

"Through this licensing agreement, Flexera will set up a 14,000 sq ft facility to manufacture chip scale packaging products. Initial production estimates are 10 million pieces per month from June 1997, increasing to 18 million pieces per month
"We expect earnings contributions of Singapore $1 million in financial year 1997, jumping to S$4.9 million in 1998," it said.
"In view of the explosive growth of the company, we remain positive on its longer term fundamentals and reiterate our buy recommendation," DBS said.
